goal: Make CGKN itself generate a fresh CS2 Demo Anomaly Lab through the reviewed Provider mainline without manual edits to generated source, then require deterministic component gates, project pytest, real authorized Demo evidence, and local_packager delivery truth.
acceptance_criteria: The accepted evidence comes only from a fresh CGKN-generated project directory produced through the reviewed API Provider route; no human or assistant may edit generated source, tests, documentation, or runtime receipts after generation begins.
The previously hand-repaired project is reference-only and cannot satisfy generated-project, test, runtime, packaging, or delivery acceptance.
API Provider generation, semantic review, post-build finalization, and goal-acceptance evidence complete through the existing reviewed route with no alternate generator or fabricated identity.
Only local_packager may emit the final bundle and delivery_manifest; unmet identity, test, runtime, review, or delivery gates remain explicit non-PASS evidence.

Runtime evidence preserves source commit, object hash and size, parser row/tick/player counts, event coverage, unknown information-state handling, view-angle proxy wording, human-review status, and NOT_EVALUATED detection accuracy.

The formal generated project passes its substantive pytest suite and one fresh opt-in online run discovers, verifies, downloads, safely extracts, parses, and reports on a genuine public CS2 demo with synthetic fallback disabled.

The prior formal run resumes only when its frozen goal hashes match, reuses only validated same-run Provider checkpoints, and writes to an isolated formal project directory without changing the already verified repaired project.
